cookProfiles.bio: Cooking authentic Andhra meals with pure homemade podis, ghee, and fresh organic ingredients. Verified by Home Cook Finder team on video call.
Wholesome North Indian Thalis, freshly hand-rolled Chapatis, and Punjabi specials made with love in my home kitchen.
Traditional Rayalaseema Ragi Mudde, Dum Biryanis, and slow-cooked home gravies passed down through 3 generations.
Hot crisp Ghee Pudi Dosa, Tiffins, Mirchi Bajji, and weekend chicken pulav prepared fresh upon your order.
Homemade Pulihora, Sambar Rice, Festival Specials, Bobbatlu and traditional sweets made with pure A2 cow ghee.
100% Pure Vegetarian Sattvic homemade meals, No Onion No Garlic options available upon request.
Fiery Telangana Natu Kodi (Country Chicken), Spicy Mutton Kheema, and authentic village-style firewood roasted spices.
Healthy home-cooked meals, Millet Upmas, Low-oil curries and protein bowls for working professionals.
Coastal Andhra style fresh Fish Pulusu, Prawn Iguru, and crispy Tawa Fish Fry delivered straight from my home pan.
Authentic festival sweets, Mysurpa, Sunnundalu, Ariselu and hot savory snacks made fresh in small batches.

menuItems.description: Thinly sliced bittergourd fried crisp with roasted garlic and red chili podi.
